svg.title: V2 FlashAttention SoC architecture
svg.desc: Synthesizable production RTL: AXI4-Lite CSR, captured-descriptor job adapter, and serial Q0 to Q3 scheduler. One reusable 16-bank Q scratchpad is separate from two persistent KV groups; Q0/Q1 share KV0 and Q2/Q3 share KV1, each with separate 16-bank K and V stores. Selected-group paired reads and foreground tile loading supply one shared 16 by 16 systolic array, 256 PEs. QK scores pass through elaboration-selected 256 or 16 dequantization lanes and sixteen masked online-softmax instances. Unnormalized softmax weights feed back to the same array for PV. PV contributions with scale_v and softmax rescale/running-sum factors feed the output buffer for fused update and final normalization. Results are copied into per-head registers, packed from 32 to 64 bits, and written through AXI write DMA. B responses return from external memory to write DMA. Matching WB tags connect job-adapter pack-start and write-descriptor control; matching RET tags connect packer source retirement and write-DMA final-OKAY/outstanding/error status to the job adapter. Host DONE requires source retirement, final accepted OKAY B, no outstanding writes and successful validation. ACK releases result ownership, separately from IRQ clear. Host, external-memory responder and verification monitors are simulation-only and outside the DUT. Cache persists across healthy jobs and ACK; softmax/output state is initialized for each query pass. Fixed 4Q:2KV, d16/d64, N16 prefill, latest-position decode L16/17/18, capacity 64 tokens. APPEND updates KV without compute/writeback; prefetch is disabled. Logical memory stores are shown, not physical ASIC macros; published PPA uses a separate frozen d16 baseline.
svg.text: 4Q:2KV · serial heads · persistent KV state · shared QKᵀ / PV compute
Matching WB / RET tags connect grouped signals.
